_comment: GTK stack manifest — the certified fork-stack pins THIS repo tag ships.
Consumed by Pitstop self-update (hostless full-stack update: assets are
fetched from THIS tag's GitHub release and sha-verified before staging).
install.sh keeps its own CERT pins for the host lane;
tools/release_sanity.sh asserts the two stay in lockstep at every cut.
kernel.requires_os: the ROCKNIX release whose module tree this kernel
matches — bin/osguard.sh activates the staged kernel ONLY when the live
OS matches (stage now, activate when coherent; never boots a mismatch).
kernel.format: image = a raw PE Image beside stock on OpenABL (20261101+);
kernel.cmdline_extra: appended to stock's options in etk-gtk.conf (bin/bls_deploy.sh).
kernel.stock_os_sha256: the OFFICIAL stock kernel per ROCKNIX release
(hashed from the upstream image's KERNEL). install.sh proves the slot is
stock against it before parking KERNEL.etk-stock: the in-place updater
never rewrites /flash/KERNEL.md5, so after an OTA that md5 is stale.
